notes: Site homeboxstores.com is behind a Cloudflare Managed Challenge (Turnstile) on every route -- confirmed still blocking on this pass: direct HTTP fetch to '/' and '/robots.txt' both returned 403 (curl + WebFetch), and plain Playwright/Chromium (both headless and headful, disable-automation flags, 15s wait) still served the 'Just a moment...' interstitial. Tier-3 Claude-in-Chrome (real logged-in Chrome session) passed the challenge on first navigation and reached the live site -- no robots.txt Claude-specific disallow found (prior pass's wayback-cached robots.txt only lists generic MJ12bot/EtaoSpider/etc disallows, no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai entry), so proceeding was in-policy. Checked: main mega-menu for all 6 top nav sections (Living, Bedroom, Dining & Kitchen, Decor & Furnishings, Kids & Young, Bath) and every subcategory flyout -- no 'Bestsellers'/'Best Sellers'/'Top Sellers'/'Popular'/'Trending' nav link anywhere. Fully enumerated sitemap_categories.xml (530 category URLs via /ae/en/sitemapindex.xml) -- zero slugs matching bestsell/topsell/popular/trending or any variant. The category PLP's own 'Sort by' dropdown does list 'Bestseller' as a SORT ORDER option (alongside New Arrivals, Discount, Price, Relevance) applied to the current category's full product set -- this is a re-sort of the whole category, not a distinct Bestsellers listing, and was confirmed non-distinct by product-count comparison (see New Arrivals/Clearance sibling files for the identical-count test on the same mechanism). Product cards also show 'BEST PRICE' merchandising badges, which are individual-product price badges, not a Bestsellers PLP signal, and no page aggregates only badge-tagged products. Site's own search (/ae/en/search?q=...) was checked but is unreliable here: a nonsense query 'zzxxqqnonsense123' returned '2000 Products' (a default/non-discriminating fallback), so search results were not used as evidence of absence, per the false-absence-test rule -- absence is established via real navigation + full sitemap enumeration instead. No genuine Bestsellers-type PLP exists on this site.
